name: KernelBench L1-P1: Square Matrix Multiplication (C = A @ B)
description: Reference PyTorch op: C = A @ B for square matrices (N=2048). The LLM must emit a custom CUDA kernel; here we model the choice of tiling/block configuration.

candidates.name: Tile 16x16 (Naive global loads)
Tile 16x32 (Uncoalesced strided memory)
candidates.code_snippet: // row-major indexing swapped -> uncoalesced global loads on B

candidates.name: Tile 64x64 (Register pressure spill)
candidates.code_snippet: __shared__ float sA[64][64], sB[64][64]; float accum[8][8]={0}; // spills to local mem

candidates.name: Tile 32x32 + SharedMem + Coalesced
Tile 8x8 (Low occupancy under-utilization)
candidates.code_snippet: #define T 8 // 64 threads/block under-utilizes SM warp schedulers

candidates.name: Tile 32x16 (Shared memory bank conflicts)
candidates.code_snippet: __shared__ float sA[32][16]; // 2-way bank conflicts on warp column reads

candidates.name: Tile 128x128 (Shared mem capacity overflow)
candidates.code_snippet: __shared__ float sA[128][128], sB[128][128]; // exceeds 48KB smem limit -> ptxas error
